description: Central registry of item identities referenced across the SCAVLAND site.

data.name: Advanced Gun Repair Kit Blueprint
data.description: This lets me learn to set up a high-quality kit for maintaining and repairing weapons very reliably.

data.name: Advanced Mechanical Components
data.description: A set of gears, levers and other high-grade machine parts. Possibly good for reuse instead of recycling.

data.name: Armor Plate
data.description: A rusty plate of armor which can be strapped to one's chest, offering minimal protection in combat. If it stops even one bullet, that’s already good enough.

data.name: Chemical Residue
data.description: A container of industrial waste from when Svarog Factories was still operational.

data.name: Expert Gun Repair Kit Blueprint
data.description: This shows me how to make a highly advanced repair kit for weapons, fit only for experts.

data.name: Fabric Scrap
data.description: An old scrap of low-quality fabric, useful for patching up clothes.

data.name: Kevlar Weave
data.description: A fabric designed for high impact resistance, usually sewn onto armor to make it bulletproof.

data.name: Makeshift Double Stacked Steel Stick Mag
Mechanical Components
data.description: Small gears, levers and bits of machinery. Not too big or high-quality, but still probably worth something.

data.name: Metal Scrap
data.description: Scraps of metal that can be recycled into something useful by able hands.

data.name: Plastic Scrap
data.description: A scrap of plastic that can maybe be recycled.

data.name: Plier
data.description: I’m not the type to pull someone’s teeth out. But what else is this thing for?

data.name: Rubber Scrap
data.description: A scrap of rubber which resisted the years. A very resilient material, and good for trading.

data.name: Screwdriver
data.description: A handy tool and it looks well-made. Could stab something with it in a pinch... Should probably just sell it.

data.name: Screws
data.description: A bunch of metal screws, hard to find and pick up but valuable for the tinkering types.

data.name: WG-40
data.description: A lubricant bottle so old and busted I’d need lubricant to open it. Still valuable for the tinkerers in Zalesye.
